posts.community: Sugar Cycles: 7-8 years of losses followed by 2-3 years of super gains!
posts.text: Sugar prices are expected to remain firm during the ongoing festive season and beyond. Despite government intervention, current retail sugar prices are in the range of ₹64–70 per kg, while ex‑mill prices stand at ₹55–56 per kg and are likely to remain around this level. This represents a significant improvement in profitability for sugar companies, as their average selling price in Q1 was only ₹40–41 per kg — translating into an increase of ₹15–16 per kg directly into their profitability.
